actual_services.application: full Laravel application and locked vendor, not a reduced kernel
actual_services.http: actual isolated front controller and native machine/node routes under UID 65534
actual_services.tls: temporary local CA verified by the client
actual_services.sources: two distinct native tasks queued, dispatched and registered through application services
actual_services.provider: existing Linode adapter with simulated HTTP responses; no external routes
actual_services.reports: synthetic client payloads sent over real HTTP/TLS; not an executed kelinode binary

prior_failures_retained.fix: Explicitly restrict the newly created temporary file before writing and publishing; existing files are never silently repaired

prior_failures_retained.finding: The integration driver expected registration readiness before the native next_check_at interval elapsed
prior_failures_retained.fix: Return native_wait and retry_at from source initialization; integration waits on real time, without modifying task timestamps

prior_failures_retained.finding: An intermediate test change used the report endpoint's nested status shape at the status endpoint
prior_failures_retained.fix: Restore the actual status route's flat payload and explicitly assert nested payload rejection

limitations_and_next_gates: This is a dual-source setup component, not completed R35 whole-round acceptance or a real cloud run

Source advance uses the actual PHP RPC handler with mocked provider HTTP; status and stop use the actual CLI subprocess. The Python strict SSH adapter is still separately simulated, not yet composed into whole-round setup ports
Native bootstrap callbacks for A and B are generated by the test client; no source installation script or real node binary was executed
The frozen ELF used in this CI is synthetic and not executed. Final unarmed runtime freezing still requires real node and dependency provenance
Control DNS/TLS must be ordered before source callbacks, and edge DNS after identity registration; this whole-round ordering remains unverified
Concrete private credential import, release publication and native execution grant issuance still need composition into the whole-round entry
Setup authority currently covers source initialization and reports. DNS initialization uses its separate component guard, not this setup capability
Partial-source cleanup before a native grant and cleanup after uncertain setup dispatch need actual interface composition and integrated failure tests
SIGKILL tests journal lock release and readback, not a process crash precisely between provider mutation and RPC reply
Expiry boundaries are unit tested; real elapsed scoped-grant expiry remains untested
The complete A1 exact cleanup, 300-second candidate retry cooldown, A2 creation and B-member noninterference lifecycle still requires assembled full-application validation
No historical live approval is reused; latest live scope and read-only preflight remain subject to a future separate user decision
